#######REVIEW

#Functions to find the cutoffs and thresholds
```{r}
find_maxstat_cutoff <- function(time_var, event_var, fraction_var, data) {
  n <- nrow(data)
  if (n < 10) return(NA_real_)
  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("survival::Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var,
                             ") ~ ", fraction_var))
  MAXSTAT <- tryCatch(
    maxstat::maxstat.test(fmla, data = data, smethod = "LogRank",
                           pmethod = "Lau92", iscores = TRUE,
                           minprop = 0.2, maxprop = 0.8),
    error = function(e) NA
  )
  if (isTRUE(is.na(MAXSTAT))) return(NA_real_)
  MAXSTAT$estimate
}

add_threshold_groups <- function(df, time_var, event_var, fraction_var = "Fraction") {
  df %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>%
    mutate(
      cutoff_maxstat  = tryCatch(find_maxstat_cutoff(time_var, event_var, fraction_var,
                                                       cur_data_all()),
                                  error = function(e) NA_real_),
      Group_maxstat   = ifelse(!is.na(cutoff_maxstat) & .data[[fraction_var]] > cutoff_maxstat,
                                "High", "Low"),
      cutoff_median   = median(.data[[fraction_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      Group_median    = ifelse(.data[[fraction_var]] > cutoff_median, "High", "Low")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# ============================================================================
# Shared convergence check for coxphf models
# Applied consistently across all univariate/multivariate DDS/RFS functions
# ============================================================================
check_convergence <- function(model, maxit_val) {
  n_iter <- model$iter
  !is.null(n_iter) &&
    all(n_iter < maxit_val) &&
    is.finite(sum(model$coefficients))
}





# One row per cell_type x threshold_type: cut-point, n and events per group
make_cutoff_table <- function(data, event_var) {

  counts_one <- function(group_col, label) {
    data %>%
      group_by(cell_type, Group = .data[[group_col]]) %>%
      summarise(n = n(),
                events = sum(.data[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(threshold_type = label)
  }

  counts <- bind_rows(counts_one("Group_maxstat", "maxstat"),
                      counts_one("Group_median",  "median")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = c(n, events),
                values_fill = 0)

  cuts <- data %>%
    distinct(cell_type, cutoff_maxstat, cutoff_median) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(cutoff_maxstat, cutoff_median),
                 names_to = "threshold_type", values_to = "cutoff") %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = sub("cutoff_", "", threshold_type))

  cuts %>%
    left_join(counts, by = c("cell_type", "threshold_type")) %>%
    transmute(cell_type, threshold_type,
              cutoff = signif(cutoff, 4),
              `n (Low/High)`      = paste0(n_Low, "/", n_High),
              `Events (Low/High)` = paste0(events_Low, "/", events_High))
}

# Adds the cut-point columns to a formatted table.
# In multivariable tables, values are shown only on the enrichment row.
add_cutoffs <- function(tab, cutoff_table) {
  tab <- tab %>%
    left_join(cutoff_table, by = c("cell_type", "threshold_type")) %>%
    relocate(cutoff, `n (Low/High)`, `Events (Low/High)`,
             .after = threshold_type)

  if ("Variable" %in% names(tab)) {
    keep <- tab$Variable == "Enrichment (High vs Low)"
    tab$cutoff[!keep]              <- NA
    tab$`n (Low/High)`[!keep]      <- NA
    tab$`Events (Low/High)`[!keep] <- NA
  }
  tab
}

```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# DISEASE-SPECIFIC DEATH (DDS) ANALYSIS
# maxstat + median + continuous Fraction
# ============================================================================


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reference levels
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_data$figo_ini_ava <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$figo_ini_ava),
  ref = "1 (Advanced)"
)

analysis_data$p53_ihc_status <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$p53_ihc_status),
  ref = "Mutant"
)



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Add DDS-specific thresholds
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_data <- add_threshold_groups(
  analysis_data,
  time_var = "time_death_surv_60m",
  event_var = "death_disease_60m",
  fraction_var = "Fraction"
)


analysis_data$Group_maxstat <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$Group_maxstat),
  ref = "Low"
)

analysis_data$Group_median <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$Group_median),
  ref = "Low"
)



cell_types_all <- unique(analysis_data$cell_type)


cutoffs_DDS <- make_cutoff_table(analysis_data, event_var = "death_disease_60m")


# Sanity check against Fig 2D risk tables:
# pDC maxstat should be 15/37, median 26/26
cutoffs_DDS %>% filter(cell_type == "Plasmacytoid dendritic cell")

# ============================================================================
# UNIVARIATE DDS
# ============================================================================


run_cox_DDS_group <- function(ct,
                              exposure_var,
                              threshold_label,
                              maxit_val = 100000) {

  df <- filter(analysis_data, cell_type == ct)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ", exposure_var))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = ct, threshold_type = threshold_label,
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)  # <-- fixed

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct, threshold_type = threshold_label,
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged  # <-- fixed
  )
}



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Maxstat
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_DDS_maxstat_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_DDS_group,
    exposure_var="Group_maxstat",
    threshold_label="maxstat"
  )
)



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Median
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_DDS_median_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_DDS_group,
    exposure_var="Group_median",
    threshold_label="median"
  )
)



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Continuous Fraction
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

run_cox_DDS_continuous <- function(ct, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df <- filter(analysis_data, cell_type == ct)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ Fraction,
           data = df, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = ct, threshold_type = "continuous",
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)  # <-- fixed

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct, threshold_type = "continuous",
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged  # <-- fixed
  )
}



univ_DDS_continuous_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_DDS_continuous
  )
)




# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine + BH correction
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_DDS_all_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  univ_DDS_maxstat_all,
  univ_DDS_median_all,
  univ_DDS_continuous_all
)



univ_DDS_all_sensitivity <- univ_DDS_all_sensitivity %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH=p.adjust(
      pval,
      method="BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_DDS_all_sensitivity_formatted <-
  univ_DDS_all_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI=sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      HR,
      lower_095,
      upper_095
    ),
    pval=round(pval,4),
    p_adj_BH=round(p_adj_BH,4)
  ) %>%
  select(
    cell_type,
    threshold_type,
    HR_CI,
    pval,
    p_adj_BH,
    n,
    n_events,
    n_iter,
    converged
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    cell_type,
    threshold_type
  )



univ_DDS_all_sensitivity_formatted <- add_cutoffs(univ_DDS_all_sensitivity_formatted, cutoffs_DDS)

kable(univ_DDS_all_sensitivity_formatted)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# MULTIVARIATE DDS — selected populations
# adjusted for FIGO + p53
# Cell types selected as the UNION of any cell type with univariate
# p_adj_BH < 0.1 under maxstat, median, OR continuous. That same set of
# cell types is then run through all three multivariate models (maxstat,
# median, continuous) -- not restricted per-threshold.
# ============================================================================

selected_cell_types_DDS <- univ_DDS_all_sensitivity %>%
  filter(p_adj_BH < 0.1) %>%
  pull(cell_type) %>%
  unique()

cat("Cell types entering ALL DDS multivariate models (maxstat, median, continuous):\n")
print(selected_cell_types_DDS)

perform_cox_analysis_DDS <- function(cell_type,
                                     data,
                                     exposure_var,
                                     covariates,
                                     maxit_val = 100000) {
  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ",
    paste(c(exposure_var, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  ))
  d <- data %>% filter(cell_type == !!cell_type)
  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = d, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type, variable = NA, coef = NA, HR = NA,
      lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)
  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,
    variable = names(model$coefficients),
    coef = model$coefficients, HR = exp(model$coefficients),
    lower_095 = model$ci.lower, upper_095 = model$ci.upper, pval = model$prob,
    n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged
  )
}

covariates_full <- c(
  "figo_ini_ava",
  "p53_ihc_status"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# All three loops now use the SAME selected_cell_types_DDS union.
# Guarded with length()>0 in case the union is ever empty.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

multiv_DDS_maxstat_selected <- if (length(selected_cell_types_DDS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      selected_cell_types_DDS,
      perform_cox_analysis_DDS,
      data = analysis_data,
      exposure_var = "Group_maxstat",
      covariates = covariates_full
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = "maxstat", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

multiv_DDS_median_selected <- if (length(selected_cell_types_DDS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      selected_cell_types_DDS,
      perform_cox_analysis_DDS,
      data = analysis_data,
      exposure_var = "Group_median",
      covariates = covariates_full
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = "median", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

# ============================================================================
# MULTIVARIATE DDS — CONTINUOUS FRACTION
# adjusted for FIGO + p53. Same selected_cell_types_DDS union as above.
# ============================================================================

perform_cox_analysis_DDS_continuous <- function(cell_type,
                                                 data,
                                                 covariates,
                                                 maxit_val = 100000) {

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ Fraction + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  d <- data %>% filter(cell_type == !!cell_type)

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = d, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type, variable = NA, coef = NA, HR = NA,
      lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,
    variable = names(model$coefficients),
    coef = model$coefficients, HR = exp(model$coefficients),
    lower_095 = model$ci.lower, upper_095 = model$ci.upper, pval = model$prob,
    n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$death_disease_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged
  )
}

multiv_DDS_continuous_selected <- if (length(selected_cell_types_DDS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      selected_cell_types_DDS,
      perform_cox_analysis_DDS_continuous,
      data = analysis_data,
      covariates = covariates_full
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = "continuous", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

if (nrow(multiv_DDS_continuous_selected) > 0) {
  multiv_DDS_continuous_selected <- multiv_DDS_continuous_selected %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = NA_real_)
  marker_rows <- multiv_DDS_continuous_selected$variable == "Fraction"
  multiv_DDS_continuous_selected$p_adj_BH[marker_rows] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_DDS_continuous_selected$pval[marker_rows], method = "BH"
  )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine maxstat + median + continuous
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

multiv_DDS_selected <- bind_rows(
  multiv_DDS_maxstat_selected,
  multiv_DDS_median_selected,
  multiv_DDS_continuous_selected
)

multiv_DDS_selected <- multiv_DDS_selected %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = ifelse(
      grepl("^Group_", variable) | variable == "Fraction",
      p.adjust(
        pval[grepl("^Group_", variable) | variable == "Fraction"],
        method = "BH"
      )[match(
        pval,
        pval[grepl("^Group_", variable) | variable == "Fraction"]
      )],
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

format_table_DDS <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      variable_label = case_when(
        grepl("^Group_", variable) ~ "Enrichment (High vs Low)",
        variable == "Fraction" ~ "Continuous (per unit)",
        variable == "figo_ini_ava0 (Initial)" ~ "FIGO (Initial)",
        variable == "p53_ihc_statusWt" ~ "p53 (Normal)",
        TRUE ~ variable
      ),
      HR_CI = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f\u2013%.4f)", HR, lower_095, upper_095),
      coef = round(coef, 4),
      pval = round(pval, 4),
      p_adj_BH = round(p_adj_BH, 4)
    ) %>%
    select(
      cell_type, threshold_type, Variable = variable_label, Coef = coef,
      `HR (95% CI)` = HR_CI, `p-value` = pval, `p (BH-adj)` = p_adj_BH,
      n, n_events, n_iter, converged
    )
}

multiv_DDS_selected_formatted <-
  format_table_DDS(multiv_DDS_selected) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, threshold_type)

multiv_DDS_selected_formatted <- add_cutoffs(multiv_DDS_selected_formatted, cutoffs_DDS)
kable(multiv_DDS_selected_formatted)
```









```{r}
# ============================================================================
# PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS ASSUMPTION -- DSS (xCell)
# Diagnostic only: coxphf (Firth) has no residuals/zph method, so this fits a
# parallel unpenalized coxph() with the identical formula purely to obtain
# Schoenfeld residual diagnostics. Effect sizes / inference for the paper
# still come from the coxphf models above.
# Now also runs the continuous ("Fraction") model, since selected_cell_types_DDS
# is the union set tested under all three thresholds.
# ============================================================================

check_ph_DDS <- function(cell_type, data, exposure_var, covariates) {

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ",
    paste(c(exposure_var, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  ))

  d <- data %>%
    filter(cell_type == !!cell_type) %>%
    mutate(
      death_disease_60m = as.numeric(as.character(death_disease_60m))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[exposure_var]]), !is.na(figo_ini_ava), !is.na(p53_ihc_status)) %>%
    droplevels()

  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(fmla, data = d), error = function(e) {
    message("coxph failed for ", cell_type, " / ", exposure_var, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(cell_type = cell_type, term = NA, chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA,
                       global_p = NA, note = "coxph_fit_failed"))
  }

  zph <- tryCatch(cox.zph(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(zph)) {
    return(data.frame(cell_type = cell_type, term = NA, chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA,
                       global_p = NA, note = "zph_failed"))
  }

  tab <- as.data.frame(zph$table)
  tab$term <- rownames(tab)
  global_p <- tab$p[tab$term == "GLOBAL"]

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type, term = tab$term, chisq = round(tab$chisq, 3), df = tab$df,
    p = round(tab$p, 4), global_p = round(global_p, 4), note = NA_character_
  )
}

ph_DDS_maxstat <- if (length(selected_cell_types_DDS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(selected_cell_types_DDS, check_ph_DDS,
           data = analysis_data, exposure_var = "Group_maxstat", covariates = covariates_full)
  ) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "maxstat", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

ph_DDS_median <- if (length(selected_cell_types_DDS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(selected_cell_types_DDS, check_ph_DDS,
           data = analysis_data, exposure_var = "Group_median", covariates = covariates_full)
  ) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "median", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

# NEW: continuous PH check -- exposure_var = "Fraction" (the raw column,
# not a Group_* factor). check_ph_DDS() is generic enough to accept this
# directly since it just builds the formula from exposure_var + covariates.
ph_DDS_continuous <- if (length(selected_cell_types_DDS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(selected_cell_types_DDS, check_ph_DDS,
           data = analysis_data, exposure_var = "Fraction", covariates = covariates_full)
  ) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "continuous", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

ph_DDS_all <- bind_rows(ph_DDS_maxstat, ph_DDS_median, ph_DDS_continuous) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, threshold_type, term)

kable(ph_DDS_all)
```







```{r}

get_cutoff_DDS <- function(threshold_type, data) {
  if (threshold_type == "maxstat") {
    find_maxstat_cutoff("time_death_surv_60m", "death_disease_60m", "Fraction", data)
  } else {
    median(data$Fraction, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

bootstrap_cutoff_DDS <- function(cell_type_val,
                                 threshold_type,
                                 data,
                                 covariates,
                                 B = 200,
                                 maxit_boot = 500,
                                 maxstep_boot = 0.5,
                                 seed = 1) {

  t0 <- Sys.time()

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(cell_type == cell_type_val)

  df0 <- df0[
    !is.na(df0$Fraction) &
    !is.na(df0$time_death_surv_60m) &
    !is.na(df0$death_disease_60m),
  ]

  cutoff0 <- get_cutoff_DDS(threshold_type, df0)

  if (is.na(cutoff0)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
      HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
      HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
      pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "cutoff_not_found"
    ))
  }

  df0$Group <- factor(
    ifelse(df0$Fraction > cutoff0, "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low", "High")
  )

  if (nlevels(droplevels(df0$Group)) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
      HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
      HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
      pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "single_group"
    ))
  }

  fmla_boot <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ Group + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit_apparent <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = 100000, pl = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_apparent) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_apparent$coefficients))) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
      HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
      HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
      pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "apparent_fit_failed"
    ))
  }

  beta_apparent <- unname(fit_apparent$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(df0)
  optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {

    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), n, replace = TRUE)
    dboot <- df0[idx, ]

    cutoff_b <- get_cutoff_DDS(threshold_type, dboot)
    if (is.na(cutoff_b)) next

    dboot$Group <- factor(ifelse(dboot$Fraction > cutoff_b, "High", "Low"),
                           levels = c("Low", "High"))
    if (nlevels(droplevels(dboot$Group)) < 2) next
    ev_tab_boot <- table(dboot$Group, dboot$death_disease_60m)
    if (ncol(ev_tab_boot) < 2 || any(ev_tab_boot[, 2] == 0)) next

    fit_boot <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = dboot, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_boot) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_boot$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_apparent <- unname(fit_boot$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

    df_test <- df0
    df_test$Group <- factor(ifelse(df_test$Fraction > cutoff_b, "High", "Low"),
                             levels = c("Low", "High"))
    if (nlevels(droplevels(df_test$Group)) < 2) next
    ev_tab_test <- table(df_test$Group, df_test$death_disease_60m)
    if (ncol(ev_tab_test) < 2 || any(ev_tab_test[, 2] == 0)) next

    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df_test, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_test) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_test$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_test <- unname(fit_test$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

    optimism_vec[b] <- beta_boot_apparent - beta_boot_test
  }

  valid_optimism <- optimism_vec[!is.na(optimism_vec)]
  n_valid <- length(valid_optimism)
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  if (n_valid < max(10, 0.2 * B)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
      HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = NA,
      HR_corrected_lower = NA, HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA,
      B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid, pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1),
      elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = "too_few_valid_bootstraps"
    ))
  }

  mean_optimism <- mean(valid_optimism)
  beta_corrected <- beta_apparent - mean_optimism
  corrected_dist <- beta_apparent - valid_optimism
  ci <- quantile(corrected_dist, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
    HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = exp(beta_corrected),
    HR_corrected_lower = exp(ci[1]), HR_corrected_upper = exp(ci[2]),
    optimism = mean_optimism, B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid,
    pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1), elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# CONTINUOUS bootstrap -- NEW, since multiv_DDS_selected now includes a
# "continuous" threshold_type stratum that also needs a corrected estimate.
# No cutoff to re-derive here; optimism is computed directly on the Fraction
# coefficient.
# ============================================================================

bootstrap_continuous_DDS <- function(cell_type_val,
                                     data,
                                     covariates,
                                     B = 1000,
                                     maxit_boot = 500,
                                     maxstep_boot = 0.5,
                                     seed = 1) {

  t0 <- Sys.time()

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(cell_type == cell_type_val,
           !is.na(Fraction), !is.na(time_death_surv_60m), !is.na(death_disease_60m))

  fmla_boot <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ Fraction + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit_apparent <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = 100000, pl = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_apparent) || !("Fraction" %in% names(fit_apparent$coefficients))) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
      HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
      HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
      pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "apparent_fit_failed"
    ))
  }

  beta_apparent <- unname(fit_apparent$coefficients["Fraction"])

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(df0)
  optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {

    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), n, replace = TRUE)
    dboot <- df0[idx, ]

    fit_boot <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = dboot, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_boot) || !("Fraction" %in% names(fit_boot$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_apparent <- unname(fit_boot$coefficients["Fraction"])

    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_test) || !("Fraction" %in% names(fit_test$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_test <- unname(fit_test$coefficients["Fraction"])

    optimism_vec[b] <- beta_boot_apparent - beta_boot_test
  }

  valid_optimism <- optimism_vec[!is.na(optimism_vec)]
  n_valid <- length(valid_optimism)
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  if (n_valid < max(10, 0.2 * B)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
      HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = NA,
      HR_corrected_lower = NA, HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA,
      B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid, pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1),
      elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = "too_few_valid_bootstraps"
    ))
  }

  mean_optimism <- mean(valid_optimism)
  beta_corrected <- beta_apparent - mean_optimism
  corrected_dist <- beta_apparent - valid_optimism
  ci <- quantile(corrected_dist, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
    HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = exp(beta_corrected),
    HR_corrected_lower = exp(ci[1]), HR_corrected_upper = exp(ci[2]),
    optimism = mean_optimism, B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid,
    pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1), elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# SELECT which (cell_type, threshold_type) combinations go into bootstrap:
# apparent multivariate p_adj_BH < 0.05, checked SEPARATELY per threshold
# (maxstat / median / continuous) -- NOT the full selected_cell_types_DDS
# union used for the multivariate stage itself.

  filter(threshold_type == "maxstat", grepl("^Group_", variable), p_adj_BH < 0.05) %>%

sig_median_DDS <- multiv_DDS_selected %>%

sig_continuous_DDS <- multiv_DDS_selected %>%

cat("\nBootstrapping CONTINUOUS DDS models for:\n"); print(sig_continuous_DDS)
```

#Visualization
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Shared helper: builds a sensible plotting order from whatever cell types
# are actually present in the data, instead of a hardcoded vector that can
# silently drop cell types the union-based p_adj<0.1/p_adj<0.05 selection
# newly includes. Aggregate scores (anything with "score" in the name) are
# grouped first, then remaining cell types alphabetically. rev() at the end
# keeps the same top-to-bottom convention as before after coord_flip().
# ============================================================================

build_cell_type_order <- function(cell_types) {
  cell_types <- unique(cell_types)
  is_score <- grepl("score", cell_types, ignore.case = TRUE)
  ordered <- c(sort(cell_types[is_score]), sort(cell_types[!is_score]))
  rev(ordered)
}
```

#Corrected HR
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# FOREST PLOT -- DSS, maxstat vs. median, bootstrap-corrected HRs
# cell_type_order is now derived from boot_df itself, so every cell type
# that made it into the bootstrap (p_adj<0.05 in the apparent multivariate
# model) is guaranteed to appear -- nothing silently dropped.
# ============================================================================

library(ggplot2)

make_optimism_forest_combined <- function(boot_df, multiv_df, title) {

  sig_df <- multiv_df %>%
    filter(Variable == "Enrichment (High vs Low)") %>%
    transmute(cell_type, threshold_type,
              significant = !is.na(`p (BH-adj)`) & `p (BH-adj)` < 0.05)

  df <- boot_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(HR_corrected), threshold_type %in% c("maxstat", "median")) %>%
    left_join(sig_df, by = c("cell_type", "threshold_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      significant = ifelse(is.na(significant), FALSE, significant),
      threshold_type = factor(threshold_type, levels = c("maxstat", "median"),
                               labels = c("Maxstat", "Median"))
    )

  cell_type_order <- build_cell_type_order(df$cell_type)
  df <- df %>% mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = cell_type_order))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = cell_type, y = HR_corrected, color = threshold_type,
                  shape = significant)) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = HR_corrected_lower, ymax = HR_corrected_upper),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), width = 0.2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_y_log10() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Maxstat" = "#D55E00", "Median" = "#0072B2"),
                        name = "Threshold") +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 16, "FALSE" = 1),
                        labels = c("TRUE" = "p.adj < 0.05", "FALSE" = "n.s."),
                        name = "Significance\n(apparent model)") +
    labs(title = title, x = "", y = "Bootstrap-corrected Hazard Ratio (log scale)") +
    theme_minimal()
}

forest_DSS <- make_optimism_forest_combined(boot_DDS_all, multiv_DDS_selected_formatted,
                                             "DSS \u2014 bootstrap-corrected HRs, maxstat vs. median")
forest_DSS
```

```{r}
library(survminer)
library(survival)

plot_km <- function(data, cell_type_val, time_var, event_var, group_var, title) {

  df <- data %>%
    filter(cell_type == cell_type_val) %>%
    mutate(!!event_var := as.numeric(as.character(.data[[event_var]]))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]]), !is.na(.data[[time_var]]), !is.na(.data[[event_var]]))

  df[[group_var]] <- droplevels(factor(df[[group_var]], levels = c("Low", "High")))

  grp_counts <- table(df[[group_var]])
  if (any(grp_counts == 0) || length(grp_counts) < 2) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "Cannot build KM plot for '%s' / %s: group counts are %s.",
      cell_type_val, group_var, paste(names(grp_counts), grp_counts, sep = "=", collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_var, ", ", event_var, ") ~ ", group_var))
  fit <- survminer::surv_fit(fmla, data = df)   # <-- changed from survival::survfit()

  ggsurvplot(
    fit, data = df, pval = TRUE, risk.table = TRUE,
    legend.title = "pDC enrichment", legend.labs = c("Low", "High"),
    title = title, palette = c("gray50", "black"),
    xlab = "Time (months)", ylab = "Survival probability"
  )
}
```

#RECURRENCE:

```{r}

# ============================================================================
# RECURRENCE (RFS) ANALYSIS
# maxstat + median + continuous Fraction
# ============================================================================


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Add recurrence-specific thresholds
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

analysis_data <- add_threshold_groups(
  analysis_data,
  time_var = "time_recurrence_surv_60m",
  event_var = "recurrence_60m",
  fraction_var = "Fraction"
)


# Set reference groups
analysis_data$Group_maxstat <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$Group_maxstat),
  ref = "Low"
)

analysis_data$Group_median <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$Group_median),
  ref = "Low"
)

cutoffs_RFS <- make_cutoff_table(analysis_data, event_var = "recurrence_60m")

# Check: pDC maxstat should be 33/19
cutoffs_RFS %>% filter(cell_type == "Plasmacytoid dendritic cell")

# ============================================================================
# UNIVARIATE RFS
# ============================================================================


run_cox_RFS_group <- function(ct,
                              exposure_var,
                              threshold_label,
                              maxit_val = 100000) {

  df <- filter(analysis_data, cell_type == ct)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ", exposure_var))

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = df, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = ct, threshold_type = threshold_label,
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)  # <-- fixed

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct, threshold_type = threshold_label,
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged  # <-- fixed
  )
}




# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Maxstat
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_RFS_maxstat_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_RFS_group,
    exposure_var = "Group_maxstat",
    threshold_label = "maxstat"
  )
)



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Median
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_RFS_median_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_RFS_group,
    exposure_var = "Group_median",
    threshold_label = "median"
  )
)



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Continuous Fraction
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

run_cox_RFS_continuous <- function(ct, maxit_val = 100000) {

  df <- filter(analysis_data, cell_type == ct)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ Fraction,
           data = df, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = ct, threshold_type = "continuous",
      coef = NA, HR = NA, lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  s <- summary(model)
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)  # <-- fixed

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct, threshold_type = "continuous",
    coef = s$coefficients, HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower, upper_095 = s$ci.upper, pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df), n_events = sum(df$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged  # <-- fixed
  )
}




univ_RFS_continuous_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_RFS_continuous
  )
)



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine all sensitivity analyses
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_RFS_all_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  univ_RFS_maxstat_all,
  univ_RFS_median_all,
  univ_RFS_continuous_all
)



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# BH correction within analysis type
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_RFS_all_sensitivity <- univ_RFS_all_sensitivity %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(
      pval,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()



# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

univ_RFS_all_sensitivity_formatted <-
  univ_RFS_all_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI = sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      HR,
      lower_095,
      upper_095
    ),
    pval = round(pval,4),
    p_adj_BH = round(p_adj_BH,4)
  ) %>%
  select(
    cell_type,
    threshold_type,
    HR_CI,
    pval,
    p_adj_BH,
    n,
    n_events,
    n_iter,
    converged
  ) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, threshold_type)


univ_RFS_all_sensitivity_formatted <- add_cutoffs(univ_RFS_all_sensitivity_formatted, cutoffs_RFS)
univ_RFS_all_sensitivity_formatted$converged <- ifelse(univ_RFS_all_sensitivity_formatted$converged, "Yes", "No")
kable(univ_RFS_all_sensitivity_formatted)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# MULTIVARIATE RFS — selected populations
# adjusted for FIGO + p53
# Cell types selected as the UNION of any cell type with univariate
# p_adj_BH < 0.1 under maxstat, median, OR continuous. That same set of
# cell types is then run through all three multivariate models (maxstat,
# median, continuous) -- not restricted per-threshold.
# ============================================================================

selected_cell_types_RFS <- univ_RFS_all_sensitivity %>%
  filter(p_adj_BH < 0.1) %>%
  pull(cell_type) %>%
  unique()

cat("Cell types entering ALL RFS multivariate models (maxstat, median, continuous):\n")
print(selected_cell_types_RFS)

perform_cox_analysis_RFS <- function(cell_type,
                                     data,
                                     exposure_var,
                                     covariates,
                                     maxit_val = 100000) {

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ",
    paste(c(exposure_var, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  ))

  d <- data %>% filter(cell_type == !!cell_type)

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = d, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type, variable = NA, coef = NA, HR = NA,
      lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  n_iter <- model$iter
  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,
    variable = names(model$coefficients),
    coef = model$coefficients, HR = exp(model$coefficients),
    lower_095 = model$ci.lower, upper_095 = model$ci.upper, pval = model$prob,
    n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(n_iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged
  )
}

covariates_full <- c(
  "figo_ini_ava",
  "p53_ihc_status"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# All three loops use the SAME selected_cell_types_RFS union.
# Guarded with length()>0 in case the union is ever empty.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected <- if (length(selected_cell_types_RFS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      selected_cell_types_RFS,
      perform_cox_analysis_RFS,
      data = analysis_data,
      exposure_var = "Group_maxstat",
      covariates = covariates_full
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = "maxstat", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

multiv_RFS_median_selected <- if (length(selected_cell_types_RFS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      selected_cell_types_RFS,
      perform_cox_analysis_RFS,
      data = analysis_data,
      exposure_var = "Group_median",
      covariates = covariates_full
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = "median", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

# ============================================================================
# MULTIVARIATE RFS — CONTINUOUS FRACTION
# adjusted for FIGO + p53. Same selected_cell_types_RFS union as above.
# ============================================================================

perform_cox_analysis_RFS_continuous <- function(cell_type,
                                                 data,
                                                 covariates,
                                                 maxit_val = 100000) {

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ Fraction + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  d <- data %>% filter(cell_type == !!cell_type)

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla, data = d, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = maxit_val),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type, variable = NA, coef = NA, HR = NA,
      lower_095 = NA, upper_095 = NA, pval = NA,
      n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_iter = NA, converged = FALSE
    ))
  }

  converged <- check_convergence(model, maxit_val)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,
    variable = names(model$coefficients),
    coef = model$coefficients, HR = exp(model$coefficients),
    lower_095 = model$ci.lower, upper_095 = model$ci.upper, pval = model$prob,
    n = nrow(d), n_events = sum(d$recurrence_60m == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_iter = paste(model$iter, collapse = ","),
    converged = converged
  )
}

multiv_RFS_continuous_selected <- if (length(selected_cell_types_RFS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      selected_cell_types_RFS,
      perform_cox_analysis_RFS_continuous,
      data = analysis_data,
      covariates = covariates_full
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = "continuous", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

if (nrow(multiv_RFS_continuous_selected) > 0) {
  multiv_RFS_continuous_selected <- multiv_RFS_continuous_selected %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = NA_real_)
  marker_rows <- multiv_RFS_continuous_selected$variable == "Fraction"
  multiv_RFS_continuous_selected$p_adj_BH[marker_rows] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_RFS_continuous_selected$pval[marker_rows], method = "BH"
  )
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine maxstat + median + continuous
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

multiv_RFS_selected <- bind_rows(
  multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected,
  multiv_RFS_median_selected,
  multiv_RFS_continuous_selected
)

multiv_RFS_selected <- multiv_RFS_selected %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = ifelse(
      grepl("^Group_", variable) | variable == "Fraction",
      p.adjust(
        pval[grepl("^Group_", variable) | variable == "Fraction"],
        method = "BH"
      )[match(
        pval,
        pval[grepl("^Group_", variable) | variable == "Fraction"]
      )],
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

format_table_RFS <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      variable_label = case_when(
        grepl("^Group_", variable) ~ "Enrichment (High vs Low)",
        variable == "Fraction" ~ "Continuous (per unit)",
        variable == "figo_ini_ava0 (Initial)" ~ "FIGO (Initial)",
        variable == "p53_ihc_statusWt" ~ "p53 (Normal)",
        TRUE ~ variable
      ),
      HR_CI = sprintf("%.4f (%.4f\u2013%.4f)", HR, lower_095, upper_095),
      coef = round(coef, 4),
      pval = round(pval, 4),
      p_adj_BH = round(p_adj_BH, 4)
    ) %>%
    select(
      cell_type, threshold_type, Variable = variable_label, Coef = coef,
      `HR (95% CI)` = HR_CI, `p-value` = pval, `p (BH-adj)` = p_adj_BH,
      n, n_events, n_iter, converged
    )
}

multiv_RFS_selected_formatted <-
  format_table_RFS(multiv_RFS_selected) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, threshold_type)

multiv_RFS_selected_formatted <- add_cutoffs(multiv_RFS_selected_formatted, cutoffs_RFS)
multiv_RFS_selected_formatted$converged <- ifelse(multiv_RFS_selected_formatted$converged, "Yes", "No")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# PROPORTIONAL HAZARDS ASSUMPTION -- RFS (xCell)
# Diagnostic only: coxphf (Firth) has no residuals/zph method, so this fits a
# parallel unpenalized coxph() with the identical formula purely to obtain
# Schoenfeld residual diagnostics. Effect sizes / inference for the paper
# still come from the coxphf models above.
# Uses selected_cell_types_RFS (the union set) and now also runs the
# continuous ("Fraction") model, matching the DSS fix.
# ============================================================================

check_ph_RFS <- function(cell_type, data, exposure_var, covariates) {

  fmla <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ",
    paste(c(exposure_var, covariates), collapse = " + ")
  ))

  d <- data %>%
    filter(cell_type == !!cell_type) %>%
    mutate(
      recurrence_60m = as.numeric(as.character(recurrence_60m))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[exposure_var]]), !is.na(figo_ini_ava), !is.na(p53_ihc_status)) %>%
    droplevels()

  fit <- tryCatch(coxph(fmla, data = d), error = function(e) {
    message("coxph failed for ", cell_type, " / ", exposure_var, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(cell_type = cell_type, term = NA, chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA,
                       global_p = NA, note = "coxph_fit_failed"))
  }

  zph <- tryCatch(cox.zph(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(zph)) {
    return(data.frame(cell_type = cell_type, term = NA, chisq = NA, df = NA, p = NA,
                       global_p = NA, note = "zph_failed"))
  }

  tab <- as.data.frame(zph$table)
  tab$term <- rownames(tab)
  global_p <- tab$p[tab$term == "GLOBAL"]

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type, term = tab$term, chisq = round(tab$chisq, 3), df = tab$df,
    p = round(tab$p, 4), global_p = round(global_p, 4), note = NA_character_
  )
}

ph_RFS_maxstat <- if (length(selected_cell_types_RFS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(selected_cell_types_RFS, check_ph_RFS,
           data = analysis_data, exposure_var = "Group_maxstat", covariates = covariates_full)
  ) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "maxstat", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

ph_RFS_median <- if (length(selected_cell_types_RFS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(selected_cell_types_RFS, check_ph_RFS,
           data = analysis_data, exposure_var = "Group_median", covariates = covariates_full)
  ) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "median", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

# continuous PH check, exposure_var = "Fraction"
ph_RFS_continuous <- if (length(selected_cell_types_RFS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(selected_cell_types_RFS, check_ph_RFS,
           data = analysis_data, exposure_var = "Fraction", covariates = covariates_full)
  ) %>% mutate(threshold_type = "continuous", .after = cell_type)
} else {
  data.frame()
}

ph_RFS_all <- bind_rows(ph_RFS_maxstat, ph_RFS_median, ph_RFS_continuous) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, threshold_type, term)

kable(ph_RFS_all)
```

#Boostrap
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# BOOTSTRAP OPTIMISM CORRECTION -- RFS multivariable models
# Re-derives the maxstat/median cutoff INSIDE each bootstrap resample
# and also re-computes the apparent cutoff on the original dataset.
# ============================================================================

get_cutoff_RFS <- function(threshold_type, data) {
  if (threshold_type == "maxstat") {
    find_maxstat_cutoff("time_recurrence_surv_60m", "recurrence_60m", "Fraction", data)
  } else {
    median(data$Fraction, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
}

bootstrap_cutoff_RFS <- function(cell_type_val,
                                 threshold_type,
                                 data,
                                 covariates,
                                 B = 200,
                                 maxit_boot = 500,
                                 maxstep_boot = 0.5,
                                 seed = 1) {

  t0 <- Sys.time()

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(cell_type == cell_type_val)

  df0 <- df0[
    !is.na(df0$Fraction) &
    !is.na(df0$time_recurrence_surv_60m) &
    !is.na(df0$recurrence_60m),
  ]

  cutoff0 <- get_cutoff_RFS(threshold_type, df0)

  if (is.na(cutoff0)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
      HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
      HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
      pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "cutoff_not_found"
    ))
  }

  df0$Group <- factor(
    ifelse(df0$Fraction > cutoff0, "High", "Low"),
    levels = c("Low", "High")
  )

  if (nlevels(droplevels(df0$Group)) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
      HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
      HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
      pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "single_group"
    ))
  }

  fmla_boot <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ Group + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit_apparent <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = 100000, pl = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_apparent) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_apparent$coefficients))) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
      HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
      HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
      pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "apparent_fit_failed"
    ))
  }

  beta_apparent <- unname(fit_apparent$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(df0)
  optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {

    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), n, replace = TRUE)
    dboot <- df0[idx, ]

    cutoff_b <- get_cutoff_RFS(threshold_type, dboot)
    if (is.na(cutoff_b)) next

    dboot$Group <- factor(ifelse(dboot$Fraction > cutoff_b, "High", "Low"),
                           levels = c("Low", "High"))
    if (nlevels(droplevels(dboot$Group)) < 2) next
    ev_tab_boot <- table(dboot$Group, dboot$recurrence_60m)
    if (ncol(ev_tab_boot) < 2 || any(ev_tab_boot[, 2] == 0)) next

    fit_boot <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = dboot, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_boot) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_boot$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_apparent <- unname(fit_boot$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

    df_test <- df0
    df_test$Group <- factor(ifelse(df_test$Fraction > cutoff_b, "High", "Low"),
                             levels = c("Low", "High"))
    if (nlevels(droplevels(df_test$Group)) < 2) next
    ev_tab_test <- table(df_test$Group, df_test$recurrence_60m)
    if (ncol(ev_tab_test) < 2 || any(ev_tab_test[, 2] == 0)) next

    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df_test, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_test) || !("GroupHigh" %in% names(fit_test$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_test <- unname(fit_test$coefficients["GroupHigh"])

    optimism_vec[b] <- beta_boot_apparent - beta_boot_test
  }

  valid_optimism <- optimism_vec[!is.na(optimism_vec)]
  n_valid <- length(valid_optimism)
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  if (n_valid < max(10, 0.2 * B)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
      HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = NA,
      HR_corrected_lower = NA, HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA,
      B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid, pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1),
      elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = "too_few_valid_bootstraps"
    ))
  }

  mean_optimism <- mean(valid_optimism)
  beta_corrected <- beta_apparent - mean_optimism
  corrected_dist <- beta_apparent - valid_optimism
  ci <- quantile(corrected_dist, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = threshold_type,
    HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = exp(beta_corrected),
    HR_corrected_lower = exp(ci[1]), HR_corrected_upper = exp(ci[2]),
    optimism = mean_optimism, B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid,
    pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1), elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# CONTINUOUS bootstrap for RFS -- mirrors bootstrap_continuous_DDS()
# ============================================================================

bootstrap_continuous_RFS <- function(cell_type_val,
                                     data,
                                     covariates,
                                     B = 1000,
                                     maxit_boot = 500,
                                     maxstep_boot = 0.5,
                                     seed = 1) {

  t0 <- Sys.time()

  df0 <- data %>%
    filter(cell_type == cell_type_val,
           !is.na(Fraction), !is.na(time_recurrence_surv_60m), !is.na(recurrence_60m))

  fmla_boot <- as.formula(paste0(
    "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ Fraction + ",
    paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")
  ))

  fit_apparent <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = 0.0001, maxit = 100000, pl = TRUE),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit_apparent) || !("Fraction" %in% names(fit_apparent$coefficients))) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
      HR_apparent = NA, HR_corrected = NA, HR_corrected_lower = NA,
      HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA, B = B, n_valid_boot = 0,
      pct_valid = 0, elapsed_sec = NA, error = "apparent_fit_failed"
    ))
  }

  beta_apparent <- unname(fit_apparent$coefficients["Fraction"])

  set.seed(seed)
  n <- nrow(df0)
  optimism_vec <- rep(NA_real_, B)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {

    idx <- sample(seq_len(n), n, replace = TRUE)
    dboot <- df0[idx, ]

    fit_boot <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = dboot, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_boot) || !("Fraction" %in% names(fit_boot$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_apparent <- unname(fit_boot$coefficients["Fraction"])

    fit_test <- tryCatch(
      coxphf(fmla_boot, data = df0, maxstep = maxstep_boot, maxit = maxit_boot, pl = FALSE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(fit_test) || !("Fraction" %in% names(fit_test$coefficients))) next
    beta_boot_test <- unname(fit_test$coefficients["Fraction"])

    optimism_vec[b] <- beta_boot_apparent - beta_boot_test
  }

  valid_optimism <- optimism_vec[!is.na(optimism_vec)]
  n_valid <- length(valid_optimism)
  elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"))

  if (n_valid < max(10, 0.2 * B)) {
    return(data.frame(
      cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
      HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = NA,
      HR_corrected_lower = NA, HR_corrected_upper = NA, optimism = NA,
      B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid, pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1),
      elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1), error = "too_few_valid_bootstraps"
    ))
  }

  mean_optimism <- mean(valid_optimism)
  beta_corrected <- beta_apparent - mean_optimism
  corrected_dist <- beta_apparent - valid_optimism
  ci <- quantile(corrected_dist, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type_val, threshold_type = "continuous",
    HR_apparent = exp(beta_apparent), HR_corrected = exp(beta_corrected),
    HR_corrected_lower = exp(ci[1]), HR_corrected_upper = exp(ci[2]),
    optimism = mean_optimism, B = B, n_valid_boot = n_valid,
    pct_valid = round(100 * n_valid / B, 1), elapsed_sec = round(elapsed, 1),
    error = NA_character_
  )
}


sig_maxstat_RFS <- multiv_RFS_selected %>%
  filter(threshold_type == "maxstat", grepl("^Group_", variable), p_adj_BH < 0.05) %>%

sig_median_RFS <- multiv_RFS_selected %>%
```

```{r}

# Full bootstrap runs, guarded for empty selections
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

B_RFS <- 1000

  bind_rows(lapply(sig_maxstat_RFS, bootstrap_cutoff_RFS,
                    threshold_type = "maxstat", data = analysis_data,
                    covariates = covariates_full, B = B_RFS))
} else data.frame()

boot_RFS_median <- if (length(sig_median_RFS) > 0) {

                    threshold_type = "median", data = analysis_data,
                    covariates = covariates_full, B = B_RFS))
} else data.frame()

boot_RFS_continuous <- if (length(sig_continuous_RFS) > 0) {
  bind_rows(lapply(sig_continuous_RFS, bootstrap_continuous_RFS,
                    data = analysis_data, covariates = covariates_full, B = B_RFS))
} else data.frame()

boot_RFS_all <- bind_rows(boot_RFS_maxstat, boot_RFS_median, boot_RFS_continuous) %>%
  arrange(cell_type, threshold_type)

kable(boot_RFS_all)
```



```{r}
forest_RFS <- make_optimism_forest_combined(boot_RFS_all, multiv_RFS_selected_formatted,
                                             "RFS \u2014 bootstrap-corrected HRs, maxstat vs. median")

forest_RFS_unadjusted <- make_forest_combined(
  multiv_df = multiv_RFS_selected_formatted,
  multiv_raw = multiv_RFS_selected,
  title = "RFS — multivariable HRs, maxstat vs. median"
)
```
